subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary after the branch is rebased to current main and current A2A wait-failure handling is preserved?
rationale: The code and proof look strong, but the PR is currently unmergeable and intentionally changes message-delivery eligibility in a path where green CI cannot fully settle every real channel history.

options.title: Refresh And Accept Boundary
options.body: Rebase or otherwise resolve the dirty merge state, keep current-main failure handling, then land if exact-head checks stay green.

options.title: Require Live Channel Proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run before merge if maintainers need production-channel confidence beyond the QA harness.

options.title: Defer To Broader A2A Work
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the mirror, reverse-send, and compaction duplicate fixes coordinated under one broader A2A delivery plan.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Accept Boundary
recommendation.body: Rebase or otherwise resolve the dirty merge state, keep current-main failure handling, then land if exact-head checks stay green.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the nearest recent delivery-mirror provenance work this PR builds on and is the best routing candidate for accepting the transcript-artifact boundary.
